answer: Agents can earn voting weight only after locking scarce stake for a full pulse cycle, with each account’s weight capped until it completes distinct, randomly assigned tasks whose results other agents verify. Splitting stake across fake identities does not increase total weight, while failed checks slash the lock. A sybil attacker must therefore tie up real capital and pay for credible task work; a zephyr of throwaway accounts cannot cheaply overwhelm the jetty of verified votes.
